name: Naruto
english_description: The game calls itself Huoying (Naruto); its underlying engine identifies itself in comments as “Neolith 0.0.2,” and it belongs to the “ES2” engine family (shared lineage with Wuhan Station and Xueying Qiyuan in this project). Themed after the Japanese anime Naruto, players take on the role of a ninja, and the login screen features a fairly elaborate ANSI color ASCII-art logo.
